title: The Nine send Puharich and Schlemmer to Egypt, Middle East and Russia

tellings.quote: in that time, they're getting messages from the nine saying, you know, you need to go to Egypt, you need to go to you know, any,

plain: Between about 1974 and 1976, the scientist Andrija Puharich, whom the episode calls a CIA scientist, and his associate Phyllis Schlemmer were getting messages from "the Nine," a council of beings they believed they were contacting, telling them to travel to Egypt, the Middle East and Russia. An unnamed researcher tells Michels this from recordings of Puharich's sessions, and also mentions a man named John Whitmore in the story. If true, the beings were not just talking but sending people on missions around the world.
